items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: A5: ENFORCE_PHASE_GATE_DEFAULT=True; every stub-artifact ok:true apply in both roots migrated to real minimal artifacts via one shared builder, no assertion weakened (none switches the gate off); e2e test plants a broken design manifest and the driven run stops (guided ask_human / autonomous failed) and passes once fixed; all 7 A4 hand-over preconditions answered (layouts proven, no raw completion left, retries via next, skip + inform decisions recorded).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: A layout whose verifiers cannot load fails closed (negative control: canon_degraded ask), and the degraded message now names the installation fix instead of reading like an artifact defect.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No config or env switch disables the gate; a new AST guard test pins that no shipped code passes enforce_gate, so --override-reason (recorded) stays the only production bypass; raw complete-phase-task ok:true stays refused and is now pinned by test_lifecycle_cli.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Run root 707+ green and integration 608+ green with the flip; new tests: 5 cache-layout probes (incl. negative control), 2 end-to-end driven-run tests asserting no completion and no successor while rejected, a pipeline-phase-has-a-validator pin, the no-production-bypass pin.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Real canon checks run per apply in the migrated tests (seconds per drive, measured: e2e 10.6s for two full drives); layout probes run once per layout in isolated subprocesses.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Builder in shared/testkit (no lib/scripts/tools package, ADR-044-safe); every touched file <=300 LOC (capstone 299, seam <=300, hardening 276); test_single_session_loop.py (grandfathered) net shrinks.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Phase-runner result contract -> single-session-apply -> phase validators/canon: round-tripped by subprocess CLI drives over builder-written artifacts in both roots; plugin-cache layout boundary (phase_validators -> shared/scripts/tools/verifiers) probed in four layouts plus the real installed cache by hand.
